# 482. License Key Formatting

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def licenseKeyFormatting(self, s, k):
        """
        :type s: str
        :type k: int
        :rtype: str
        """
        new_s = s.replace("-", "").upper()
        ans = []
        p = 0
        cnt = len(new_s) % k
        if cnt != 0:
            ans.append(new_s[:cnt])
            p = cnt
        while p < len(new_s):
            ans.append(new_s[p: p + k])
            p = p + k
        return "-".join(ans)
```
